schema.text: When people use this connection, how is crossing controlled?

options.text: There is no signal or clear priority
Vehicles should give way, but there is no signal
There is a signal and conflicting vehicles are stopped when people cross
There is a signal, but turning vehicles may still cross the path
There is a signal, but priority is unclear
I don't know / I cannot tell

en.#When people use this connection, how is: When people use this connection, how is crossing controlled?
en.#There is no signal or clear priority: There is no signal or clear priority
en.#Vehicles should give way, but there is: Vehicles should give way, but there is no signal
en.#There is a signal and conflicting vehic: There is a signal and conflicting vehicles are stopped when people cross
en.#There is a signal, but turning vehicles: There is a signal, but turning vehicles may still cross the path
en.#There is a signal, but priority is uncl: There is a signal, but priority is unclear
en.#I don't know / I cannot tell: I don't know / I cannot tell

it.#When people use this connection, how is: Come è regolato l'attraversamento di questo collegamento?
it.#There is no signal or clear priority: Non c'è semaforo né precedenza chiara
it.#Vehicles should give way, but there is: I veicoli dovrebbero dare precedenza, ma non c'è semaforo
it.#There is a signal and conflicting vehic: C'è un semaforo e i veicoli in conflitto sono fermi quando le persone attraversano
it.#There is a signal, but turning vehicles: C'è un semaforo, ma i veicoli in svolta possono ancora attraversare il percorso
it.#There is a signal, but priority is uncl: C'è un semaforo, ma la precedenza non è chiara
it.#I don't know / I cannot tell: Non lo so / non riesco a capirlo

fr.#When people use this connection, how is: Lorsque des personnes utilisent cette liaison, comment la traversée est-elle régulée ?
fr.#There is no signal or clear priority: Il n’y a ni signalisation ni priorité claire
fr.#Vehicles should give way, but there is: Les véhicules devraient céder le passage, mais il n’y a pas de signalisation
fr.#There is a signal and conflicting vehic: Il y a un feu et les véhicules en conflit sont arrêtés pendant la traversée
fr.#There is a signal, but turning vehicles: Il y a un feu, mais les véhicules qui tournent peuvent encore couper le passage
fr.#There is a signal, but priority is uncl: Il y a un feu, mais la priorité n’est pas claire
fr.#I don't know / I cannot tell: Je ne sais pas / je ne peux pas le déterminer

de.#When people use this connection, how is: Wie wird die Querung geregelt, wenn Personen diese Verbindung nutzen?
de.#There is no signal or clear priority: Es gibt kein Signal und keinen klaren Vorrang
de.#Vehicles should give way, but there is: Fahrzeuge sollten Vorfahrt gewähren, aber es gibt kein Signal
de.#There is a signal and conflicting vehic: Es gibt ein Signal, und kreuzende Fahrzeuge werden während der Querung angehalten
de.#There is a signal, but turning vehicles: Es gibt ein Signal, aber abbiegende Fahrzeuge können den Weg weiterhin kreuzen
de.#There is a signal, but priority is uncl: Es gibt ein Signal, aber der Vorrang ist unklar
de.#I don't know / I cannot tell: Ich weiß es nicht / ich kann es nicht beurteilen

tr.#When people use this connection, how is: İnsanlar bu bağlantıyı kullanırken geçiş nasıl kontrol ediliyor?
tr.#There is no signal or clear priority: Sinyal veya açık bir geçiş önceliği yok
tr.#Vehicles should give way, but there is: Araçlar yol vermeli, ancak sinyal yok
tr.#There is a signal and conflicting vehic: Sinyal var ve insanlar geçerken çakışan araçlar durduruluyor
tr.#There is a signal, but turning vehicles: Sinyal var, ancak dönen araçlar yolu kesmeye devam edebilir
tr.#There is a signal, but priority is uncl: Sinyal var, ancak geçiş önceliği belirsiz

fa.#When people use this connection, how is: هنگام استفاده مردم از این ارتباط، عبور چگونه کنترل می‌شود؟
fa.#There is no signal or clear priority: هیچ چراغ یا حق‌تقدم روشنی وجود ندارد
fa.#Vehicles should give way, but there is: خودروها باید راه بدهند، اما چراغی وجود ندارد
fa.#There is a signal and conflicting vehic: چراغ وجود دارد و هنگام عبور مردم، خودروهای متعارض متوقف می‌شوند
fa.#There is a signal, but turning vehicles: چراغ وجود دارد، اما خودروهای در حال گردش ممکن است همچنان مسیر را قطع کنند
fa.#There is a signal, but priority is uncl: چراغ وجود دارد، اما حق‌تقدم روشن نیست

hu.#When people use this connection, how is: Hogyan szabályozzák az átkelést, amikor az emberek ezt a kapcsolatot használják?
hu.#Vehicles should give way, but there is: A járműveknek elsőbbséget kellene adniuk, de nincs jelzés
hu.#There is a signal and conflicting vehic: Van jelzés, és átkeléskor a keresztező járművek megállnak
hu.#There is a signal, but turning vehicles: Van jelzés, de a kanyarodó járművek még keresztezhetik az útvonalat
hu.#There is a signal, but priority is uncl: Van jelzés, de az elsőbbség nem egyértelmű

ar.#When people use this connection, how is: كيف يُنظَّم العبور عند استخدام الأشخاص لهذا الرابط؟
ar.#There is no signal or clear priority: لا توجد إشارة أو أولوية واضحة
ar.#Vehicles should give way, but there is: ينبغي للمركبات إعطاء الأولوية، لكن لا توجد إشارة
ar.#There is a signal and conflicting vehic: توجد إشارة وتتوقف المركبات المتعارضة أثناء عبور الأشخاص
ar.#There is a signal, but turning vehicles: توجد إشارة، لكن المركبات المنعطفة قد تظل تقطع المسار
ar.#There is a signal, but priority is uncl: توجد إشارة، لكن الأولوية غير واضحة
